paper_title: Online Convex Optimization with Heavy Tails: Old Algorithms, New Regrets, and Applications
statement: However, in contrast to Theorem 1, we suspect Theorem 7 is not tight in T for p ∈ (1, 2). The reason is that for nonsmooth strongly convex optimization with heavy tails (i.e., ℓt = F, ∀t ∈ [T ] where F is strongly convex), Theorem 7 can convert to a convergence rate only in the order of 1/T p−1 , which is worse than the lower bound 1/T 2−2/p (Zhang et al., 2020a). Therefore, we conjecture that a way to obtain a better regret bound than T 2−p exists, which we leave as future work.
